_finding: Owner, 22.11: show how many agents and programs really use the service, and who. The count comes from names clients send about themselves, over seven days; a name we do not recognise is counted and never printed, because a client may call itself anything and a stranger's word must not reach our page.

mutations.name: any name a client sends is printed
mutations.find: for (const [x, k] of daysByName) if (KNOWN_APPS[x]) known.set(KNOWN_APPS[x], Math.max(known.get(KNOWN_APPS[x]) || 0, k))
mutations.replace: for (const [x, k] of daysByName) known.set(x, k)
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and never prints a name it does not recognise

mutations.name: one day counts as coming back
mutations.expect: FAIL ...back on two days or more counts a name seen on two days

mutations.name: no name and other count as apps
mutations.expect: FAIL apps are the distinct names over the window, never "(no name)" or "other", case folded
